hypothesis: Among the 8 papers, mixup (1710.09412) and/or CutMix (1905.04899) will provide the most practical accuracy boost for a small 2-conv CNN on CIFAR-10, as they are proven regularization techniques that work well with limited compute. SGDR (1608.03983) may complement these as a scheduling improvement.
conclusion: Cycle 0: idea_agent completed paper research phase. All 8 papers were analyzed (mixup, CutMix, SGDR, Cutout, AutoAugment, Label Smoothing, AdamW, WideResNet) and IDEA_NOTES.md was created. Recommended primary methods: mixup [arXiv:1710.09412] or CutMix [arXiv:1905.04899] (+2-4% expected), with SGDR [arXiv:1608.03983] as secondary (+1-3%).
